name: unpaired-high-surrogate-escape
description: A lone high surrogate written as a JSON escape. V3's UTF-8 scan does not see it — the frame bytes are valid UTF-8 and the surrogate only appears once the escape is resolved.
notes: Found by ROJ-44's differential fuzzing. Go substituted U+FFFD and accepted; Jason rejected. V3 had already decided this — valid UTF-8 has no representation for an unpaired surrogate — so the Go codec was out of spec. Escaped rather than raw on purpose: raw surrogate bytes are a V3 rejection and a different code path.
